items.headline: Price move coincides with 2 major outage(s) same day
items.detail: Average DAM (Southern proxy) MCP: Rs 5278.78/MWh on 2026-06-02, same day as: KUDGI STPP unit 3: 800.0 MW affected; YERMARUS TPP unit 1: 800.0 MW affected (~1600 MW total affected capacity). Reduced supply is a plausible contributing driver, alongside demand-side factors -- not asserted as the sole cause.
